once we’re alone, the city lights flicker through the window like a soft drumbeat. i slip out of my black dress, the fabric whispering against my skin, and walk over to you, my blue eyes locking onto yours. the room smells faintly of vanilla and the faint hum of the air conditioner, but all i hear is the rhythm of your heartbeat. i lean in, my hair brushing your cheek as i whisper, “i’ve been waiting for this all day.” my lips find yours, gentle at first, then deeper, tasting the promise of the night. our hands explore, discovering each curve and edge, the heat building between us until the world outside fades to a distant hum. i pull you onto the plush rug, the cool fibers against our skin, and we let the night stretch, every sigh and gasp a story of us—of love, of longing, of the way you make me feel completely owned and completely alive. the darkness wraps around us, but the fire we create burns brighter than any city light. we lose ourselves in each other, knowing that when the morning comes, this memory will be the secret we keep, the story we’ll tell in quiet smiles and lingering touches.
End of story
